labelOrigin: Agent-drafted from reading the code at the pinned commit (CLA-289); pending Brenton's spot-check before counting as ground truth.

questions.question: What happens on the server when a shopper hits the button to put a product in their basket?
questions.answerNote: Form calls the addItem server action (useActionState); addItem calls addToCart, which reads the cartId cookie and sends the cartLinesAdd GraphQL mutation via shopifyFetch, then updateTag(TAGS.cart) refreshes cached cart data. Client-side cart-context applies an optimistic update first.

questions.question: When a merchant edits a product in their store admin, how does the website stop showing the stale version?
questions.answerNote: Shopify webhooks POST to /api/revalidate; revalidate() checks the ?secret against SHOPIFY_REVALIDATION_SECRET, reads the x-shopify-topic header and calls revalidateTag for the products or collections cache tag. Always answers 200 so Shopify doesn't retry.

questions.question: Which file renders the page for a single item when someone opens its link?
questions.answerNote: App Router dynamic segment app/product/[handle]/page.tsx: awaits params.handle, calls getProduct(handle), notFound() if missing, renders gallery + description and JSON-LD; generateMetadata sets SEO/robots from the product.

questions.question: Where do plain content pages like 'About' or 'Terms' come from — are they written in the repo?
questions.answerNote: Not in the repo: the catch-all app/[page]/page.tsx fetches the page body from Shopify via getPage(handle) (pageByHandle query) and renders its HTML with Prose.

questions.question: What settings do I need to supply to connect this storefront to my own shop?
questions.answerNote: .env.example lists COMPANY_NAME, SITE_NAME, SHOPIFY_REVALIDATION_SECRET, SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_ACCESS_TOKEN, SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN; validateEnvironmentVariables in lib/utils.ts throws if the two Shopify vars are missing or the domain still contains brackets.

questions.question: Can I run this against a different ecommerce platform instead, and what would I need to replace?
questions.answerNote: README 'Providers' section: Vercel only maintains Shopify; other providers fork and swap out the lib/shopify implementation while leaving the rest of the template mostly unchanged (lists BigCommerce, Medusa, Saleor, etc.).

questions.question: Where are the sort choices like 'price low to high' or 'latest arrivals' defined?
questions.answerNote: lib/constants.ts exports the sorting list (Relevance, Trending=BEST_SELLING, Latest arrivals=CREATED_AT reverse, Price asc/desc) with URL slugs; search pages map the ?sort slug to sortKey/reverse.

questions.question: When a shopper chooses a size or colour, how does the site work out which exact version of the product gets added?
questions.answerNote: VariantSelector writes each chosen option into the URL query string (router.replace) and disables unavailable combos; AddToCart finds the variant whose selectedOptions all match the search params (or the only variant) and submits its id.

c4Note.note: One container for a single Next.js app is right, but the component level is just a flat list of 66 one-file components with no grouping, so the atlas never shows the three things a maintainer would name: App Router routes (app/), UI components (components/, with cart as its own feature), and the Shopify provider adapter (lib/shopify). The commerce backend (Shopify Storefront API) is the key external dependency and is absent. Config files show up as architecture components.
expectedContainers: external: Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) + Shopify webhooks
problems: 66 components, one per file, under a single container; no directory grouping (app/, components/cart, components/layout, lib/shopify)
lib/shopify split into 13 file components (fragments/, queries/, mutations/, types) instead of one 'Shopify adapter' component
next.config.ts and postcss.config.mjs modelled as components
no external system for Shopify even though every data call goes through shopifyFetch to the Storefront GraphQL endpoint
.env.example and README (config + provider-swap guidance) invisible to the model

overviews.note: Summary states what it is (Next.js + Shopify) and the app/components/lib split; key points point at the Shopify gateway; single-container children is only navigation.
Summary names lib/shopify as the gateway; key points add the cart hand-off and revalidate gotcha; 66 route/component files are real but mostly thin; parent is redundant.
